user.title: Set up Access Guard
user.description: Access Guard restricts individual users (sidebar, media, cameras, …) and logs who signed in when and from which device. Settings are under “Configure”, the overview is the new “Access” sidebar item.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Access Guard is already set up.

select_user.title: Choose user
select_user.description: Restrictions apply to every device of this user. For administrators they only partly apply – staff should be regular users.

restrictions.title: Restrictions for {user}
restrictions.description: **Blocked** means removed from the sidebar and also unreachable by link or API. **Hidden** only removes it from the sidebar. Open browser tabs pick up changes after a reload.

data_description.blocked_areas: Blocks the area including its data. History, logbook, to-do and calendar cards on dashboards stop working too.
data_description.blocked_dashboards: The user can neither see nor open these dashboards.
data_description.hidden_panels: Hide only – still reachable by link.
data_description.hidden_entities: The user can't see these entities anywhere (dashboards, search, history) or control them.

logging.title: Log
logging.description: The log contains personal data (times, IP addresses, devices). Inform your staff and keep it only as long as needed.

data.log_sessions: Log sessions (when the app/browser was open)

abort.no_users: There are no users that can be restricted.

options.media: Media – media browser incl. UniFi Protect clips
options.cameras: Cameras – live view, snapshots, recordings, camera entities
